summary.en: From the map into one part and back: the whole system as layers, zoom into one, walk one task through it until it stops, return and name the next part.
summary.zh: 从总图进入一部分再回来：整个系统分层，放大一层，走一个任务直到停下，回到总图，点出下一部分。

fits: A narrated explainer of 30–90 s teaching one part of a system (one part an episode).
notFor: Arguments from counts (use count-then-rule); systems without a map.

intent.en: Teach one part without losing the whole: the viewer leaves and returns to the same map.
intent.zh: 讲一部分而不丢掉整体：观众离开又回到同一张图。

content.en: A question, a system map, one part to enlarge, one task through it, a line to remember, the next part.
content.zh: 一个问题、一张系统图、一个要放大的部分、一个穿过它的任务、一句要记住的话、下一部分。

fits.zh: 30–90 秒讲系统某一部分的解说片（一集讲一部分）。

notFor.zh: 用计数讲道理（用 count-then-rule）；没有总图的系统。

en: Return to the same map with the part marked; a new map breaks the series.
zh: 回到同一张图并标出讲过的部分；换图会断了系列。

source.path: the source film; the source film
